title: A pipeline of views
description:
Write `std::vector<int> evenSquares(const std::vector<int>& values)` that keeps the even numbers and squares them, using a view pipeline:

```cpp
values | std::views::filter(isEven) | std::views::transform(square)
```

A view does no work until something loops over it. Loop over the pipeline and collect the results into a vector.
